text:
mara: OK team — quick sync: launch posts for Catalyst next week. Need benchmark narrative, webinar plan, and PLG funnel tie-ins (free credits, prompt packs, onboarding nudges). Can we lock content + experiment matrix today?
leo: On benchmark — I can run 3 variant narratives: 'cost-savings', 'latency win', 'developer story'. Which to prioritize?
anya: developer story + prompt templates example. We should pair each post with a 1-click prompt pack link.
jen: Webinar: proposed Wed 2pm PT. 30min demo + 15 Q&A. Signup flows should push starter credits (100 tokens) + opt-in to promptpack. Also need routing for inbound leads: tag 'webinar-signup' + source param.
sam: I can build routing in GA + send events to Growth webhook. Can we A/B the credit amount? 100 vs 250?
mara: Yes. Experiment matrix: credit amount (100/250), onboarding CTA (promptpack vs sample prompt), email cadence (1 vs 3). We'll track activation in 7 days.
leo: Heads up: for the benchmark we need determinism. I'll run gen on the three scenarios and capture latency/cost per 1k tokens.
anya: Copy snippets for posts — I'll draft 3 short variants. Also recommend adding a 'starter prompt template' for SEO.
jen: For signup routing: add hidden param utm_campaign=catalyst_launch and header 'x-source: social' when from posts. Growth webhook can map that to 'seed_cohort'.
sam: I'll add mapping. Also propose fallback for high volume: route to dedicated pool or show 'we'll email you a replay' if capacity low.
ops-bot: deploy reminder: webinar-workflow-v1 doc created https://redwood.docs/ops/webinar-workflow-v1 
mara: Nice. Need microcopy for activation nudges — short push: 'Try this prompt: Generate a landing page for your app in 30s' Any takers to craft?
anya: I'll throw 3 copy options in the doc.
leo: Question: how do we measure 'quality' regression? We'll attach a small eval set to the funnel and run weekly.
mara: Good. Sam — set up event 'promo_credit_redeemed' and 'promptpack_installed'.
sam: On it. ETA end of day.
jen: I'll update webinar landing with code snippet for promptpack install:
```js
fetch('/api/promptpacks/install', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ pack_id: 'starter-catalyst', source: 'webinar' })
})
```
jen: Also adding hidden inputs: `<input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="catalyst_launch">`
mara: Great. Quick checklist: 1) benchmark runs (leo) 2) post copy + assets (anya) 3) landing + webhook + events (jen/sam) 4) experiment matrix + tracking (mara/sam) 5) microcopy nudges (anya).
leo: I'll drop the benchmark CSV into the docs page when ready. :thumbsup: 
anya: Drafts by EOD.
sam: Routing + events deployed to dev, will push to prod after smoke.
ops-bot: reminder: add replay gating rule if capacity > 90% during event.
mara: Awesome — please ping here when live. Let's keep the post cadence tight: teaser (Mon), deep-dive thread (Wed morning), webinar post (Wed 90m before).
jen: Got it. I'll schedule the 90m reminder + follow-up email with promptpack link.
mara: Thanks all — ship it. :rocket:
